changes.title: Ossoff says "zero interest in running for president" in Georgia debate
changes.summary: Sen. Jon Ossoff and Republican challenger Mike Collins traded attacks over the 2020 election and alleged connections to white nationalists. Ossoff also pushed back on speculation that he could run for president in 2028.

changes.title: In heated Georgia Senate debate, Jon Ossoff says he won’t run for president in 2028
changes.summary: The Democratic incumbent pledged to serve a full term as he and challenger Rep. Mike Collins hit on similar themes as in their first debate last week.
